description: People with no recorded contact in either direction for a while, quietest first, with the latest contact date. Use for relationships that have gone quiet, not as a ranking of who is worth contacting. Coverage is limited to covered connected sources and imported metadata. `days` sets the threshold; the default is six months. A person with `date_known` false has a last date older than the mail read so far: say only `quiet_for`, never a date or a number of days. Never call someone this did not return quiet on other evidence: take their last date only from get_graph_object for that same person, never from mail found while looking up someone else.

days.description: Quiet for at least this many days. Default 182.

name: quiet_contacts
title: Who has gone quiet
